_about: AOS-SFR-2026-001 instrument, version 1.0, frozen 16 September 2026 as the sweep wrote it (intermediation.py, RESALE and SERVICE). Over an INTERMEDIATED notice's description, case-insensitive: resale-shaped if RESALE matches and SERVICE does not; service-shaped if SERVICE matches and RESALE does not; both; neither. This is a term test over a description string and not a reading of any notice. Provenance: written by the author from the vocabulary seen in the P2 descriptions on 16 September 2026, then widened twice the same day after the first run left notices whose descriptions read 'VSA6', 'Azure Environment', 'Microsoft VSA6' and the like in the neither bucket: the terms vsa (without a trailing word boundary), azure, backup, hosting, toolkit, as a service, m365, copilot, sharepoint, dynamics, teams and volume sourcing were added after results were seen.
